tests.name: Native pairing route
tests.evidence: POST /pair accepted a hyphenated six-digit code and returned X-Sakura-Token-compatible token.

tests.name: API pairing alias
tests.evidence: POST /api/pairing/verify returned token, session, session_token and sessionToken aliases.

tests.name: Model inventory
tests.evidence: Both /models and /api/models returned gemma3:4b and embeddinggemma from mock Ollama.

tests.name: API JSON chat
tests.evidence: POST /api/chat proxied a non-streaming Ollama response.

tests.name: BridgeClient native protocol
tests.evidence: Synthetic Node harness used /status, /pair and /models and preserved native protocol.

tests.name: BridgeClient API fallback
tests.evidence: Synthetic Node harness converted a 404 from /status into /health, /api/pairing/verify, /api/models and /api/chat.

tests.name: Real Vercel and Windows validation
tests.evidence: Requires the user PC, Chrome local-network permission, real Ollama models and deployed Vercel origin.
